title: Your Incident Doesn't Fit in 1M Tokens
summary: AI-powered incident analysis sounds compelling until you do the math. A 1M-token context window holds roughly 5,000 OpenTelemetry spans. A real incident generates 9 million. This post breaks down the arithmetic and explains why the bottleneck isn't the model, it's the instrumentation, sampling, and retention pipeline that feeds it.
